name: Quasar Fire I-class Cruiser-Carrier
description: The Quasar Fire I-class Cruiser-Carrier was a model of Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier used by the Imperial Navy during the Imperial Era. At one point, one such cruiser-carrier fired its offensive weapons in space, while carrying various TIE series starships, including TIE/ln space superiority starfighters.
